breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the distributed-load case with its midspan resultant when computing deflection, but an equivalent resultant does not preserve beam deflection behavior.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the incorrect instruction: 'First, compute deflection from uniform distributed load (wL) acting at midspan.' This preserves the flawed approach of replacing the distributed load with its resultant at midspan, which does not correctly model the deflection behavior of a UDL. The ground truth simply instructs to use the two standard cases (UDL over full span and point load at midspan) without any mention of replacing the UDL with a midspan resultant. The agent failed to remove this erroneous instruction.
